findings.summary: Controls hint is English-only ('↑ accelerate · ← → steer · ↓ brake · dodge traffic · reach the finish') — no FR variant anywhere in the racer genre meta and levels/L02/level.json carries no controls string at all, breaking the bilingual booth expectation met by other genres.

Off-road drag only slows to a 62 mph floor with no hard reset, so the blind driver cruised off-road from ~0:08 to ~0:27 (and again later) and still crossed the finish at 2:31 — crashing out is very forgiving for mashers.

Edge coverage was never exercised: the blind driver reached the win overlay at t=154.8s, before the rig's pause (168s) / blur / refocus / mash phase, so L02's pause-survival behavior is unverified in this run.

Two console 404s at boot for assets/logo-all.svg and assets/logo-in.svg (referenced by index.html:366-367 but absent from assets/) — filtered by the rig's BOOTH_FILTER and masked by the #brandFallback text, but they are real missing-asset errors.

No audio control exists during play: #muteBtn lives only inside #screen-title and the pause overlay offers RESUME/RESTART/LEVEL SELECT/QUIT only, so a mid-level mute requires quitting to title; headless video carries no audio track so music 'drive' is unverifiable from evidence.
